identity.title: Risk-Based Local-First CI Optimization
identity.objective: Implement base-trusted, default-off risk-based selective final hosted CI with Tier1 Ubuntu smoke, Tier2 Ubuntu full plus relevant audit/frontend, and Tier3 full legacy nine-job matrix, while preserving protected-boundary escalation, exact-head final gate, local authoritative full testing, and Karl-only activation/merge.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CI-OPT-02 workflow/classifier/docs/tests to restore the nine-job local-first S10-CI-OPT-01 workflow. With CI_RISK_ROUTING_ENABLED absent/false the implemented workflow itself already runs the original nine legs. No product state, credentials, execution or capital changed.

api_matrix.reason: Only CI job selection, classifier local CLI and stable final-status surface change; product APIs are untouched

items.before: one non-draft fixed five-job topology expands to nine runners
items.after: base-owned non-draft classifier selects Tier1/2/3, dynamic nonempty compatibility matrix, conditional audits/NDFD/frontend and stable ci-final-gate; default OFF retains legacy nine
items.compatibility_requirement: Preserve four Python full cross-platform targets, two native NDFD targets, both Python audit jobs and frontend for Tier3; no new workflow trigger or additional workflow

items.after: stdlib bounded offline base-trusted classification from actual Git diff provenance and verified WP authority, fixed tier/plan output; no head-owned downgrade
items.compatibility_requirement: No product API or shell execution from untrusted paths; invalid data rejects or conservative high tier without PASS

items.before: final job evidence distributed across nine current hosted jobs
items.after: one unique non-matrix final check rejects missing required jobs and mismatched plan/head; actual expanded legs still independently inspected
items.compatibility_requirement: Do not represent GitHub branch protection as enabled or a skipped job as passed; enforce only after Karl explicitly configures required status

semantic_fields.reason: The ten bounded governance decisions below are the complete scope, with no separate policy registry

items.required_rule: default-off equals Tier 3 unless the exact Karl-owned variable is true and activation protection is independently verified; the initial CI-OPT-02 head runs all nine legacy legs
items.validation_rule: false/unset/malformed and first-bootstrap tests require four compat/two NDFD/two audits/frontend; never claim activation

items.required_rule: derive minimum hosted tier using base-owned classifier, complete changed-path provenance and authority impact, never PR-controlled labels as trust
items.validation_rule: negative modified renamed deleted symlink truncated and missing-spec tests fail closed

items.required_rule: positively self-contained docs metadata and benign isolated stdlib utilities only; one Ubuntu py3.12 smoke job plus final gate
items.validation_rule: known safe docs are Tier 1; protected docs/validator changes cannot be Tier 1

items.required_rule: default substantive noncritical public wallet, Alpha, Hermes research, research scheduler, ordinary app/backend/frontend and noncritical deployment; RUNTIME risk3 not an automatic escalation
items.validation_rule: Tier 2 ubuntu py3.12 full plus base audit; frontend only on relevant changes and no default NDFD/windows

items.required_rule: specific privileged auth/credentials/signing/orders/live/execution/hard-risk/capital/economic reconciliation/CI-security enforcement/native dependency or proven OS compatibility impact
items.validation_rule: critical paths and CI-OPT-02 own head require exact four compat/two NDFD/two audits/frontend

items.required_rule: canonical bounded output binds actual base/head and nonempty exact matrix, boolean audit/ndfd/frontend flags and reason codes
items.validation_rule: bad refs invalid JSON missing outputs mismatched matrix or zero matrix produce non-ready result

items.required_rule: one unique ci-final-gate evaluates actual needs outcomes including skipped/nonapplicable and exact source head; a required skip/failure/cancel is never PASS
items.validation_rule: negative matrix on failures/cancels/skips/needs unknown/head mismatch always fails

items.required_rule: retain strict DuckDB, Nautilus/SDK pins, both Python audit commands, exact single historical fsspec CVE exception, NDFD binary no-skip and frontend npm audit when relevant
items.validation_rule: tier3 guards prove no silent reduction; no second ignore or masking

items.required_rule: local one authoritative full suite on stable head, real exact-head hosted required checks and manual expanded-job inspection; disclose skips and measure actual runner-minutes
items.validation_rule: first five postactivation eligible PRs compared with eight-run historical 36.3 min average

items.required_rule: no src runtime, dependencies, product network, credentials, orders, host activation, actual CI activation or repo settings edits
items.validation_rule: exact 13 paths, original nine-leg bootstrap and Karl-only merge/activation
